title: Calibrated Target Noise Recovers Curvature from the Gradients
abstract: arXiv:2611.07671v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Estimating curvature information from gradients alone is a fundamental problem in machine learning. The challenge becomes particularly acute in settings where only aggregate mini-batch gradients are available, yet curvature information is still required for applications such as preconditioning in optimisation, sampling, and early stopping. Perhaps surprisingly, we show that a simple target-perturbation scheme suffices to recover such curvature information from gradients alone. Our method injects zero-mean noise into the targets, with variance calibrated to the local output curvature. The covariance of the resulting noisy batch gradients then recovers practical curvature matrices, without requiring per-sample gradients, second-order derivatives, or other internal network quantities. translated_title: 校准的目标噪声从梯度中恢复曲率信息
translated_abstract: 仅从梯度估计曲率信息是机器学习中的一个基本问题。在只有聚合的小批量梯度可用、但仍需要曲率信息的场景下（例如优化中的预条件、采样和提前停止等应用），这一挑战尤为突出。也许令人惊讶的是，我们证明一种简单的目标扰动方案就足以仅从梯度中恢复此类曲率信息。我们的方法向目标中注入零均值噪声，其方差根据局部输出曲率进行校准。由此产生的含噪批量梯度（noisy batch gradients）的协方差即可恢复实用的曲率矩阵，而无需逐样本梯度、二阶导数或其他网络内部量。对于一大类非线性模型，我们的方案可以恢复广义高斯-牛顿（GGN）矩阵；对于前馈ReLU网络，它还能额外恢复（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种向目标注入方差经局部输出曲率校准的零均值噪声的简单方法，使得含噪批量梯度的协方差能够仅从梯度中恢复出广义高斯-牛顿（GGN）等曲率矩阵，无需逐样本梯度或二阶导数。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simple target-perturbation scheme that injects zero-mean noise with variance calibrated to the local output curvature, enabling the covariance of noisy batch gradients to recover practical curvature matrices such as the Generalised Gauss-Newton (GGN) matrix from gradients alone, without requiring per-sample gradients or second-order derivatives.
